import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
package pipeline;

public class Importer {

    import java.io.BufferedReader;
    import java.io.IOException;
    import java.nio.file.Files;
    import java.nio.file.Path;
    import java.util.*;
    import java.util.concurrent.*;
    import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVFormat;
    import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVParser;
    import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVRecord;

    // Existing class content goes here
}

public final class Importer {
    public static final boolean WORKERS_ENABLED = true;
    public static final int NUM_WORKERS = Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors();

    static Map<String, Double> totals = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    static AtomicInteger rowCount = new AtomicInteger(0);
    static Map<String, Integer> skippedRows = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public static final class Summary {
        public final int skus;
        public final int rows;
        public final Map<String, Double> totals;
        public final Map<String, Integer> skippedRows;

        public Summary(int skus, int rows, Map<String, Double> totals, Map<String, Integer> skippedRows) {
            this.skus = skus;
            this.rows = rows;
            this.totals = totals;
            this.skippedRows = skippedRows;
        }
    }

    static List<String> knownSkus(List<Map<String, String>> rows) {
        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
        for (Map<String, String> r : rows) {
            seen.add(r.get("sku"));
        }
        return new ArrayList<>(seen);
    }

    static void accumulate(Map<String, String> row) {
        String sku = row.get("sku");
        try {
            String quantityStr = row.get("quantity");
            String priceStr = row.get("unit_price").replace("$", "");

            if (quantityStr == null || priceStr == null || quantityStr.isEmpty() || priceStr.isEmpty()) {
                skippedRows.merge("missing_or_blank", 1, Integer::sum);
                return;
            }

            double quantity = Double.parseDouble(quantityStr);
            double price = Double.parseDouble(priceStr);
            double value = quantity * price;

            totals.merge(sku, value, Double::sum);
            rowCount.incrementAndGet();
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            skippedRows.merge("malformed_number", 1, Integer::sum);
        }
    }

    static void worker(List<Map<String, String>> rows) {
        for (Map<String, String> row : rows) {
            accumulate(row);
        }
    }

    public static List<Map<String, String>> load(String path) throws IOException {
        List<Map<String, String>> out = new ArrayList<>();
        try (BufferedReader br = Files.newBufferedReader(Path.of(path))) {
            CSVParser parser = new CSVParser(br, CSVFormat.DEFAULT.withFirstRecordAsHeader().withIgnoreHeaderCase().withTrim());
            for (CSVRecord record : parser) {
                Map<String, String> row = new HashMap<>();
                record.toMap().forEach(row::put);
                out.add(row);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static Summary summarize(String path) throws Exception {
        totals.clear();
        rowCount.set(0);
        skippedRows.clear();
        List<Map<String, String>> rows = load(path);
        List<String> skus = knownSkus(rows);

        if (WORKERS_ENABLED) {
            ForkJoinPool pool = new ForkJoinPool(NUM_WORKERS);
            int chunk = Math.max(1, rows.size() / NUM_WORKERS);
            List<Callable<Void>> tasks = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < rows.size(); i += chunk) {
                List<Map<String, String>> slice = rows.subList(i, Math.min(i + chunk, rows.size()));
                tasks.add(() -> {
                    worker(slice);
                    return null;
                });
            }
            pool.invokeAll(tasks);
            pool.shutdown();
        } else {
            worker(rows);
        }

        return new Summary(skus.size(), rowCount.get(), totals, skippedRows);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        String path = args.length > 0 ? args[0] : Path.of("data", "feed.csv").toString();
        Summary result = summarize(path);
        System.out.printf("Imported %d rows covering %d SKUs%n", result.rows, result.skus);
        List<String> keys = new ArrayList<>(result.totals.keySet());
        Collections.sort(keys);
        for (String sku : keys) {
            System.out.printf("  %s: %.2f%n", sku, result.totals.get(sku));
        }
        System.out.println("Skipped rows:");
        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : result.skippedRows.entrySet()) {
            System.out.printf("  %s: %d%n", entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
        }
    }

    public static final boolean WORKERS_ENABLED = true;
    public static final int NUM_WORKERS = Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors();

    static Map<String, Double> totals = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    static AtomicInteger rowCount = new AtomicInteger(0);
    static Map<String, Integer> skippedRows = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public static final class Summary {
        public final int skus;
        public final int rows;
        public final Map<String, Double> totals;
        public final Map<String, Integer> skippedRows;

        public Summary(int skus, int rows, Map<String, Double> totals, Map<String, Integer> skippedRows) {
            this.skus = skus;
            this.rows = rows;
            this.totals = totals;
            this.skippedRows = skippedRows;
        }
    }

    static List<String> knownSkus(List<Map<String, String>> rows) {
        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
        for (Map<String, String> r : rows) {
            seen.add(r.get("sku"));
        }
        return new ArrayList<>(seen);
    }

    static void accumulate(Map<String, String> row) {
        String sku = row.get("sku");
        try {
            String quantityStr = row.get("quantity");
            String priceStr = row.get("unit_price").replace("$", "");

            if (quantityStr == null || priceStr == null || quantityStr.isEmpty() || priceStr.isEmpty()) {
                skippedRows.merge("missing_or_blank", 1, Integer::sum);
                return;
            }

            double quantity = Double.parseDouble(quantityStr);
            double price = Double.parseDouble(priceStr);
            double value = quantity * price;

            totals.merge(sku, value, Double::sum);
            rowCount.incrementAndGet();
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            skippedRows.merge("malformed_number", 1, Integer::sum);
        }
    }

    static void worker(List<Map<String, String>> rows) {
        for (Map<String, String> row : rows) {
            accumulate(row);
        }
    }

    public static List<Map<String, String>> load(String path) throws IOException {
        List<Map<String, String>> out = new ArrayList<>();
        try (BufferedReader br = Files.newBufferedReader(Path.of(path))) {
            CSVParser parser = new CSVParser(br, CSVFormat.DEFAULT.withFirstRecordAsHeader().withIgnoreHeaderCase().withTrim());
            for (CSVRecord record : parser) {
                Map<String, String> row = new HashMap<>();
                record.toMap().forEach(row::put);
                out.add(row);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static Summary summarize(String path) throws Exception {
        totals.clear();
        rowCount.set(0);
        skippedRows.clear();
        List<Map<String, String>> rows = load(path);
        List<String> skus = knownSkus(rows);

        if (WORKERS_ENABLED) {
            ForkJoinPool pool = new ForkJoinPool(NUM_WORKERS);
            int chunk = Math.max(1, rows.size() / NUM_WORKERS);
            List<Callable<Void>> tasks = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < rows.size(); i += chunk) {
                List<Map<String, String>> slice = rows.subList(i, Math.min(i + chunk, rows.size()));
                tasks.add(() -> {
                    worker(slice);
                    return null;
                });
            }
            pool.invokeAll(tasks);
            pool.shutdown();
        } else {
            worker(rows);
        }

        return new Summary(skus.size(), rowCount.get(), totals, skippedRows);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        String path = args.length > 0 ? args[0] : Path.of("data", "feed.csv").toString();
        Summary result = summarize(path);
        System.out.printf("Imported %d rows covering %d SKUs%n", result.rows, result.skus);
        List<String> keys = new ArrayList<>(result.totals.keySet());
        Collections.sort(keys);
        for (String sku : keys) {
            System.out.printf("  %s: %.2f%n", sku, result.totals.get(sku));
        }
        System.out.println("Skipped rows:");
        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : result.skippedRows.entrySet()) {
            System.out.printf("  %s: %d%n", entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
        }
    }
}
